related_questions.question: When will the new COVID vaccine be available in 2025?

text_blocks.snippet: The new COVID-19 vaccine, formulated for the 2025-2026 season, is expected to be available in the fall of 2025. The FDA's Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee (VRBPAC) met on May 22, 2025 to recommend a monovalent JN.1-lineage vaccine composition. The CDC recommends a 2024-2025 COVID-19 vaccine for most adults 18 and older.

related_questions.question: Who can get the Novavax vaccine?
related_questions.snippet: The FDA is now approving the vaccine for people 65 years and older, and those ages 12 through 64 who have at least one health condition that puts them at increased risk for a severe outcome from COVID. The 2024-2025 Novavax vaccine, sold in the U.S. under the brand name Nuvaxovid™, became available in August 2024.
